title: Citrix NetScaler Virtual Server
description: A virtual server (vserver) object from the Citrix NetScaler NITRO API, representing either a load balancing or content switching virtual server that accepts incoming client traffic and distributes or routes it to backend services.

name.description: Name for the virtual server. Must begin with a letter, number, or underscore character and must contain only alphanumeric, hyphen, period, hash, space, at, equals, colon, and underscore characters.

servicetype.description: Protocol of the service running on the virtual server.

ipv46.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to assign to the virtual server. This is typically a Virtual IP (VIP) address on the NetScaler used as the entry point for client traffic.

port.description: Port number on which the virtual server listens for client connections.

td.description: Traffic domain identifier to isolate traffic for this virtual server from other traffic domains on the appliance.

ipset.description: Name of the IP set to bind to the virtual server, providing multiple IP addresses for the virtual server.

range.description: Number of consecutive IP addresses that the appliance must generate beginning from the VIP address.

ippattern.description: IP address pattern for identifying packets to be accepted by the virtual server. Used together with ipmask.

ipmask.description: IP address mask applied with the IP pattern to form an IP address range for packet matching.

lbmethod.description: Load balancing method used to select the backend service for each client request. Applicable only to load balancing virtual servers.

backuplbmethod.description: Backup load balancing method used when the primary method fails to select a service.

persistencetype.description: Type of persistence for the virtual server. Ensures requests from the same client are directed to the same backend service.

persistencebackup.description: Backup persistence type for the virtual server.

timeout.description: Persistence timeout in minutes. Duration for which persistence sessions are maintained after the last matching request.

clttimeout.description: Client idle timeout in seconds. Time the NetScaler waits before closing an idle client connection.

cookiename.description: Name of the HTTP cookie generated by the NetScaler for cookie-insert persistence.

comment.description: Informational description or comments about the virtual server.

state.description: Administrative state of the virtual server.

curstate.description: Current operational state of the virtual server. This is a read-only property reflecting the runtime status.
enum: DOWN WHEN GOING OUT OF SERVICE

effectivestate.description: Effective state of the virtual server considering all contributing factors.
enum: DOWN WHEN GOING OUT OF SERVICE

status.description: Current status code of the virtual server. A value of 1 indicates the virtual server is UP.

statechangetimesec.description: Timestamp of the last state change for the virtual server.

tickssincelaststatechange.description: Number of system ticks elapsed since the last state change.

totalservices.description: Total number of services bound to this virtual server.

activeservices.description: Number of currently active (UP) services bound to this virtual server.

health.description: Health of the virtual server expressed as a percentage of UP services relative to total bound services.

somethod.description: Spillover method that defines the condition under which traffic overflows to the backup virtual server.

sothreshold.description: Threshold value for the spillover method. The meaning varies based on the spillover method selected.

sopersistence.description: Whether to maintain persistence sessions when spillover occurs.

sopersistencetimeout.description: Persistence timeout in minutes during spillover conditions.

healththreshold.description: Minimum percentage of UP services required for the virtual server to be considered UP.

redirecturl.description: URL to which client requests are redirected when all bound services are DOWN.

downstateflush.description: Whether to flush all active transactions on all bound services when the virtual server transitions to DOWN.

insertvserveripport.description: Whether to insert the virtual server VIP address and port number into the HTTP request header.

vipheader.description: Name of the HTTP header in which the VIP address and port are inserted.

disableprimaryondown.description: Whether to continue directing traffic to the virtual server when it is DOWN in an HA deployment.

authentication.description: Whether authentication is enabled for the virtual server.

authenticationhost.description: Fully qualified domain name of the authentication virtual server to which users are redirected for authentication.

authn401.description: Whether to use HTTP 401-based authentication instead of redirect-based authentication.

authnvsname.description: Name of the authentication virtual server to use for 401-based authentication.

push.description: Whether to process traffic with the push virtual server bound to this virtual server.

pushlabel.description: Expression for extracting a label from the incoming request for push functionality.

pushmulticlients.description: Whether to allow multiple clients to connect to the push virtual server.

icmpvsrresponse.description: How the NetScaler appliance responds to ICMP ping requests directed at the VIP address.

rhistate.description: Route Health Injection state. Controls whether the route to the VIP is advertised via dynamic routing protocols when the server is UP.

appflowlog.description: Whether to enable AppFlow logging for the virtual server to capture traffic analytics.

connfailover.description: Connection failover mode for the virtual server in HA deployments.

precedence.description: Type of precedence to apply for content switching policy evaluation. Applicable only to content switching virtual servers.

casesensitive.description: Whether URL-based content switching is case sensitive. Applicable only to content switching virtual servers.

lbvserver.description: Name of the default load balancing virtual server bound to this content switching virtual server.

targetlbvserver.description: Name of the target load balancing virtual server to which matching content is switched.

cachetype.description: Cache type for integrated caching on the virtual server.

isgslb.description: Whether this virtual server is a GSLB (Global Server Load Balancing) virtual server.
